      - n_no_grad students with NO graduation date (always currently enrolled)

             '@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .',
             'uni:TestDeptEU a uni:Department ; uni:belongsTo uni:%s .' % country_dept,
             'uni:TCourse a uni:Course ; uni:isTaughtIn uni:TestDeptEU .',
             'uni:TestProf a uni:Person ; uni:hasName "Test Prof" ; '
             'uni:role "Professor of Testing" ; uni:worksIn uni:TestDeptEU .']
    idx = 5000
    for _ in range(n_no_grad):
        idx += 1
        lines.append(f'uni:TS{idx} a uni:Person ; uni:role "Student" ; '
                     f'uni:isEnrolledIn uni:TCourse ; '
                     f'uni:hasEnrollmentDate "2024-01-01"^^xsd:date .')
    for d in grad_dates:
        idx += 1
        lines.append(f'uni:TS{idx} a uni:Person ; uni:role "Student" ; '
                     f'uni:isEnrolledIn uni:TCourse ; '
                     f'uni:hasEnrollmentDate "2024-01-01"^^xsd:date ; '
                     f'uni:hasGraduationDate "{d}"^^xsd:date .')
    return BASE_TTL + "\n" + "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

base_act = run(BASE_TTL, SOL)
if base_exp != base_act:
    failures.append(f"[base] {sorted(base_act.items())} != {sorted(base_exp.items())}")
# Pin the concrete expected answer so a query that silently returns nothing fails.
PINNED = {
    "Aristotle Tympas": frozenset({"GR"}),
    "Orfeas Menis":     frozenset({"GR", "US"}),   # US proves output != EU filter
    "Pepe Attanasio":   frozenset({"GR", "PT"}),

if base_act != PINNED:
    failures.append(f"[base pinned] got {sorted(base_act.items())} expected {sorted(PINNED.items())}")

# ============================================================================
# Boundary battery. In each, TestProf works ONLY in TestDeptEU, so TestProf
# qualifies IFF that single department has > 10 currently-enrolled students.
# ============================================================================

# (1) COUNT boundary: exactly 10 currently enrolled -> NOT > 10 -> excluded.
check("count==10 (not >10)", augment(10, []))
if "Test Prof" in run(augment(10, []), SOL):
    failures.append("[count==10] TestProf must be EXCLUDED at exactly 10 (>10 boundary)")

# (2) COUNT boundary: exactly 11 currently enrolled -> > 10 -> included.
check("count==11 (>10)", augment(11, []))
if "Test Prof" not in run(augment(11, []), SOL):
    failures.append("[count==11] TestProf must be INCLUDED at 11 (>10 boundary)")

# (3) DATE boundary combined with capacity: 10 non-grad + 1 graduating EXACTLY
#     on REF (2025-08-16). Under the contract that student is STILL currently
#     enrolled -> 11 -> included. A '<=' off-by-one would drop them -> 10 ->
#     excluded, which this scenario detects.
ttl_exact = augment(10, ["2025-08-16"])
check("10 + grad==REF -> 11 currently enrolled", ttl_exact)
if "Test Prof" not in run(ttl_exact, SOL):
    failures.append("[grad==REF] a student graduating exactly on 2025-08-16 must "
                    "count as currently enrolled (< not <=); TestProf must be INCLUDED")

# (4) DATE boundary just BEFORE REF combined with capacity: 10 non-grad + 1
#     graduating 2025-08-15 (strictly before) -> that student is NOT currently
#     enrolled -> 10 -> excluded. Detects a '<=' -> '<' style over-inclusion the
#     other direction and confirms strictly-before is dropped.
ttl_before = augment(10, ["2025-08-15"])
check("10 + grad<REF -> still 10", ttl_before)
if "Test Prof" in run(ttl_before, SOL):
    failures.append("[grad<REF] a student graduating 2025-08-15 must NOT count as "
                    "currently enrolled; TestProf must be EXCLUDED")

# (5) DATE boundary just AFTER REF combined with capacity: 10 non-grad + 1
#     graduating 2025-08-17 -> still enrolled -> 11 -> included.
ttl_after = augment(10, ["2025-08-17"])
check("10 + grad>REF -> 11", ttl_after)
if "Test Prof" not in run(ttl_after, SOL):
    failures.append("[grad>REF] a student graduating 2025-08-17 must count as "
                    "currently enrolled; TestProf must be INCLUDED")

# (6) EU boundary combined with capacity: same 11-strong department but attached
#     to a NON-EU university (ETH Zurich, CH) -> criterion 2 fails -> excluded,
#     even though the >10 capacity is satisfied.
ttl_noneu = augment(11, [], country_dept="ETHZurich")
check("11 students but non-EU (CH)", ttl_noneu)
if "Test Prof" in run(ttl_noneu, SOL):
    failures.append("[non-EU] TestProf in a CH university must be EXCLUDED despite >10 students")

# (7) FULL-PROFESSOR boundary combined with capacity: same 11-strong EU dept but
#     the person is an Assistant Professor -> criterion 1 fails -> excluded.
ttl_asst = augment(11, []).replace(
    'uni:role "Professor of Testing"', 'uni:role "Assistant Professor of Testing"')
if "Test Prof" in run(ttl_asst, SOL):
    failures.append("[assistant] an Assistant Professor must be EXCLUDED despite EU + >10 students")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if failures:
    print("FAIL:")
    for f in failures:
        print("  -", f)
    sys.exit(1)

print("Query result on real graph (verified):")
for n in sorted(base_act):
    print(f"  {n} -> {', '.join(sorted(base_act[n]))}")

      "(count >10 edge, graduation-date </==/> reference, EU, full-professor).")
